'''Tasia's Tapcafé''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] which was in business on a hangar deck level of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The restaurant served food from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of its proprietor, [[Brun Brux]]. After the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]], the establishment became a rallying point for [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] survivors and those with resentment for the Empire. The back wall of the restaurant became a impromptu memorial for the planet with customers leaving [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] and messages for the [[Death/Legends|dead]], the survivors and the defiant. Brux commiserated with those passing through, being saddened and angry [[Gender/Legends|himself]], although he discouraged active rebellion for fear of attracting the attention of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]].<ref name="BTR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Shortly after a [[message pod]] was discovered near the Wheel, a group of around twenty individuals had gathered outside of Tasia's Tapcafé. The group however came to block the way of the crew of the ''[[Nightflyer]]'', a salvage vessel belonging to the [[Yiyar Salvage]] company, who were attempting to steal the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[IT-3PO]] on a [[V5 medium cargo floater]]. The group forced the crowd to disperse which caused them to become more of an obstacle for the group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] chasing the crew and trying to recover the droid.<ref name="BTR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tasia's Tapcafé was first introduced in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] in [[2013]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. It was one location players could potentially travel to while searching for information during the first episode of the game. The establishments involvement in the chase is only a suggested obstacle for players and does not necessarily need to be included.
